business_problem: MyLÚA Health needed an enterprise-ready way to deliver culturally attuned maternal support between appointments while protecting sensitive health information and identifying risk earlier in underserved populations.
solution_summary: MyLÚA Health partnered with IBM to build a multi-agent maternal-wellness platform that combines support, personalization and risk detection. IBM watsonx.ai provides the governed multilingual AI environment used to personalize responses and apply responsible AI controls, while IBM watsonx Orchestrate coordinates specialized agents across emotional, physical and social support domains. The platform runs on IBM Cloud with IBM Cloud Code Engine using FastAPI, Postgres and Redis so it can scale securely for regulated workloads. Users interact with the LÚA experience through mobile channels, and the agents translate those requests into check-ins, reminders, education and local resource activation. The same platform also supports structured summaries for doulas and care coordinators and early identification of postpartum-depression risk, all while keeping personally identifiable and protected health information away from large language models.
